cases.source:
match value over
    on is structural Point as val p -> { process(p); }
    on _ -> fallback(); end
end

match value over
    on 1 -> process(1); end
    on _ -> process(2); end
end

match value over
    on 1 -> process(1); end
    on _ -> { process(2); }
end

match value over
    on 1 ->
        val x = 1;
        process(x);
    end
    on _ -> fallback(); end
end

match value over
    on 1 ->
        if ready then process(1); fi
    end
    on _ -> fallback(); end
end

match value over
    on 1 ->
        match nested over
            on 2 -> { process(2); }
            on _ -> { fallback(); }
        end
    end
    on _ -> fallback(); end
end

match value over
    on is ~Point as val p when p.x > 0 ->
        process(p: ~p, count: 1);
    end
    on _ -> fallback(); end
end

match value over
    on 1 -> end
    on _ -> end
end

do match value over
    on 1 -> process(1); end
    on _ -> { fallback(); }
end

match value over
    on 1 -> process(1);
    on _ -> fallback(); end
end

match value over
    on 1 -> process(1); end
    on _ -> fallback(); end

match value over
    on 1 -> process(1); end
    on _ -> fallback(); end
end
end
